description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dippitiyawaththa, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District   -  Cad. Map No.  420202
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership, and title settlement - all core elements of the Land Gazettes classification category.
